newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee steady in forward dollar market.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee steady in forward dollar market.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) intervened in the forward dollar market on Monday, for the fourth successive day, rolling over swaps maturing in December, dealers said.
Premia on forward dollars rose on paying pressure from importers before falling back on receiving pressure from the RBI, they said.
"The RBI was rolling over swaps maturing in December," said a dealer at a state-run bank. "It was receiving and this pushed down premia a bit."
Dealers said there was some paying pressure also from importers and this was keeping premia steady.

Spot-May opened Monday at 123/125 paise, down from the weekend close of 126/129, a dealer said. "It rose on paying pressure to 126/129 but RBI's intervention has eased it back to around 123/125 now," he said.
